q-seneca-aliena.ipa: /ˈɔm.nɪ.a luː.ˈkiː.liː a.lɪ.ˈeː.na sʊnt ˈtɛm.pʊs ˈtan.tʊm ˈnɔs.trʊm ɛst/
q-seneca-aliena.respelling: OM-nih-ah loo-KEE-lee ah-lih-AY-nah sunt TEHM-pus TAHN-tum NOS-trum ehst
q-seneca-aliena.latin: Omnia, Lūcīlī, aliēna sunt, tempus tantum nostrum est.

q-virgil-arma.ipa: /ˈar.ma wɪ.ˈrʊm.kʷɛ ˈka.noː ˈtroːj.jae̯ kʷiː ˈpriː.mʊs ab ˈoː.riːs iː.ˈta.lɪ.am ˈweː.nɪt/
q-virgil-arma.respelling: AHR-mah wih-RUM-kweh KAH-noh TROHY-yeye kwee PREE-mus ahb OH-rees ee-TAH-lih-ahm WAY-niht
q-virgil-arma.latin: Arma virumque canō, Trōiae quī prīmus ab ōrīs Ītaliam … vēnit.

q-martial-bona.ipa: /sʊnt ˈbɔ.na sʊnt ˈkʷae̯.dam mɛ.dɪ.ˈɔ.krɪ.a sʊnt ˈma.la ˈpluː.ra kʷae̯ ˈlɛ.gɪs hiːk/
q-martial-bona.respelling: sunt BO-nah sunt KWEYE-dahm meh-dih-O-krih-ah sunt MAH-lah PLOO-rah kweye LEH-gihs heek
q-martial-bona.latin: Sunt bona, sunt quaedam mediocria, sunt mala plūra quae legis hīc.

q-horace-sapere.ipa: /diː.ˈmɪ.dɪ.ʊm ˈfak.tiː kʷiː ˈkoe̯.pɪt ˈha.bɛt ˈsa.pɛ.rɛ ˈau̯.deː ˈɪŋ.kɪ.pɛ/
q-horace-sapere.respelling: dee-MIH-dih-um FAHK-tee kwee KOY-piht HAH-beht SAH-peh-reh OW-day IHNG-kih-peh
q-horace-sapere.latin: Dīmidium factī, quī coepit, habet; sapere audē, incipe.

q-cicero-historia.ipa: /hɪs.ˈtɔ.rɪ.a ˈweː.roː ˈtɛs.tɪs ˈtɛm.pɔ.rʊm luːks weː.rɪ.ˈtaː.tɪs ˈwiː.ta mɛ.ˈmɔ.rɪ.ae̯ ma.ˈgɪs.tra ˈwiː.tae̯ ˈnuːn.tɪ.a wɛ.tʊs.ˈtaː.tɪs/
q-cicero-historia.respelling: hihs-TO-rih-ah WAY-roh TEHS-tihs TEHM-po-rum looks way-rih-TAH-tihs WEE-tah meh-MO-rih-eye mah-GIHS-trah WEE-teye NOON-tih-ah weh-tus-TAH-tihs
q-cicero-historia.latin: Historia vērō testis temporum, lūx vēritātis, vīta memoriae, magistra vītae, nūntia vetustātis.

i-pantheon-agrippa.ipa: /a.ˈgrɪp.pa kɔs ˈtɛr.tɪwm ˈfɛ.kɪt ˈmaːr.kʊs a.ˈgrɪp.pa ˈluː.kɪ.iː ˈfiː.lɪ.ʊs ˈkoːn.sʊl ˈtɛr.tɪ.ʊm ˈfeː.kɪt/
i-pantheon-agrippa.respelling: ah-GRIHP-pah kos TEHR-tihwm FEH-kiht MAHR-kus ah-GRIHP-pah LOO-kih-ee FEE-lih-us KOHN-sul TEHR-tih-um FAY-kiht
i-pantheon-agrippa.latin: M·AGRIPPA·L·F·COS·TERTIVM·FECIT — Mārcus Agrippa, Lūciī fīlius, cōnsul tertium, fēcit.

q-horace-modus.ipa: /ɛst ˈmɔ.dʊs ɪn ˈreː.bʊs sʊnt ˈkɛr.tiː ˈdeː.nɪ.kʷɛ ˈfiː.neːs/
q-horace-modus.respelling: ehst MO-dus ihn RAY-bus sunt KEHR-tee DAY-nih-kweh FEE-nays
q-horace-modus.latin: Est modus in rēbus, sunt certī dēnique fīnēs.

q-virgil-timeo.ipa: /ˈkʷɪd.kʷɪd ɪd ɛst ˈtɪ.mɛ.oː ˈda.na.oːs ɛt ˈdoː.na fɛ.ˈrɛn.teːs/
q-virgil-timeo.respelling: KWIHD-kwihd ihd ehst TIH-meh-oh DAH-nah-ohs eht DOH-nah feh-REHN-tays
q-virgil-timeo.latin: Quidquid id est, timeō Danaōs et dōna ferentēs.

q-tacitus-urbem.respelling: UR-behm ROH-mahm ah preeng-KIH-pih-oh RAY-gays hah-bu-AY-reh
q-tacitus-urbem.latin: Urbem Rōmam ā prīncipiō rēgēs habuēre.

q-juvenal-mens.ipa: /oː.ˈran.dʊm ɛst ʊt sɪt meːns ˈsaː.na ɪn ˈkɔr.pɔ.rɛ ˈsaː.noː/
q-juvenal-mens.respelling: oh-RAHN-dum ehst ut siht mayns SAH-nah ihn KOR-po-reh SAH-noh
q-juvenal-mens.latin: Ōrandum est ut sit mēns sāna in corpore sānō.

q-catullus-ave.ipa: /ˈat.kʷɛ ɪn pɛr.ˈpɛ.tʊ.ʊm ˈfraː.tɛr ˈa.weː ˈat.kʷɛ ˈwa.leː/
q-catullus-ave.respelling: AHT-kweh ihn pehr-PEH-tu-um FRAH-tehr AH-way AHT-kweh WAH-lay
q-catullus-ave.latin: Atque in perpetuum, frāter, avē atque valē.

i-titus-spqr.ipa: /ˈsɛ.natws ˈpɔpwlwsq.wɛ ˈrɔ.manws ˈdɪ.wɔ ˈtɪ.tɔ ˈdɪ.wɪ wɛs.pa.ˈsɪ.a.nɪ ˈɪ.lɪ.ɔ wɛs.pa.ˈsɪ.a.nɔ ˈawgws.tɔ/
i-titus-spqr.respelling: SEH-nahtws POPWLWSQ-weh RO-mahnws DIH-wo TIH-to DIH-wih wehs-pah-SIH-ah-nih IH-lih-o wehs-pah-SIH-ah-no AHWGWS-to
i-titus-spqr.latin: SENATVS POPVLVSQVE ROMANVS DIVO TITO DIVI VESPASIANI F[ILIO] VESPASIANO AVGVSTO

q-catullus-odi.ipa: /ˈoː.diː ɛt ˈa.moː ˈkʷaː.reː ɪd ˈfa.kɪ.am fɔr.ˈtas.sɛ rɛ.ˈkʷiː.rɪs ˈnɛs.kɪ.oː sɛd ˈfɪ.ɛ.riː ˈsɛn.tɪ.oː ɛt ɛks.ˈkrʊ.kɪ.ɔr/
q-catullus-odi.respelling: OH-dee eht AH-moh KWAH-ray ihd FAH-kih-ahm for-TAHS-seh reh-KWEE-rihs NEHS-kih-oh sehd FIH-eh-ree SEHN-tih-oh eht ehks-KRU-kih-or
q-catullus-odi.latin: Ōdī et amō. quārē id faciam, fortasse requīris. nesciō, sed fierī sentiō et excrucior.

q-horace-dulce.ipa: /ˈdʊl.kɛ ɛt dɛ.ˈkoː.rʊm ɛst proː ˈpa.trɪ.aː ˈmɔ.riː/
q-horace-dulce.respelling: DUL-keh eht deh-KOH-rum ehst proh PAH-trih-ah MO-ree
q-horace-dulce.latin: Dulce et decōrum est prō patriā morī.

q-virgil-forsan.respelling: FOR-sahn eht heyek OH-lihm meh-mih-NIHS-seh yu-WAH-biht
q-virgil-forsan.latin: Forsan et haec ōlim meminisse iuvābit.

q-seneca-vindica.ipa: /ˈɪ.ta fak miː luː.ˈkiː.liː ˈwɪn.dɪ.kaː teː ˈtɪ.bɪ/
q-seneca-vindica.respelling: IH-tah fahk mee loo-KEE-lee WIHN-dih-kah tay TIH-bih
q-seneca-vindica.latin: Ita fac, mī Lūcīlī: vindicā tē tibi.

q-resgestae-annos.ipa: /ˈan.noːs uːn.deː.wiː.ˈgɪn.tiː ˈnaː.tʊs ɛk.ˈsɛr.kɪ.tʊm priː.ˈwaː.toː koːn.ˈsɪ.lɪ.oː ɛt priː.ˈwaː.taː ɪm.ˈpeːn.saː kɔm.pa.ˈraː.wiː/
q-resgestae-annos.respelling: AHN-nohs oon-day-wee-GIHN-tee NAH-tus ehk-SEHR-kih-tum pree-WAH-toh kohn-SIH-lih-oh eht pree-WAH-tah ihm-PAYN-sah kom-pah-RAH-wee
q-resgestae-annos.latin: Annōs ūndēvīgintī nātus exercitum prīvātō cōnsiliō et prīvātā impēnsā comparāvī.

q-virgil-regere.ipa: /tuː ˈrɛ.gɛ.rɛ ɪm.ˈpɛ.rɪ.oː ˈpɔ.pʊ.loːs roː.ˈmaː.nɛ mɛ.ˈmɛn.toː ˈpar.kɛ.rɛ sʊ.bɪ.ˈɛk.tiːs ɛt deː.bɛl.ˈlaː.rɛ sʊ.ˈpɛr.boːs/
q-virgil-regere.respelling: too REH-geh-reh ihm-PEH-rih-oh PO-pu-lohs roh-MAH-neh meh-MEHN-toh PAHR-keh-reh su-bih-EHK-tees eht day-behl-LAH-reh su-PEHR-bohs
q-virgil-regere.latin: Tū regere imperiō populōs, Rōmāne, mementō … parcere subiectīs et dēbellāre superbōs.

q-virgil-fugit.respelling: sehd FU-giht ihn-TEH-reh-ah FU-giht ihr-reh-pah-RAH-bih-leh TEHM-pus
q-virgil-fugit.latin: Sed fugit intereā, fugit irreparābile tempus.

q-ovid-gutta.respelling: GUT-tah KAH-waht LAH-pih-dehm kohn-SOO-mih-tur AH-nu-lus OO-soo
q-ovid-gutta.latin: Gutta cavat lapidem, cōnsūmitur ānulus ūsū.

q-cicero-cedant.respelling: KAY-dahnt AHR-mah TO-geye kong-KAY-daht LOW-reh-ah LOW-dee
q-cicero-cedant.latin: Cēdant arma togae, concēdat laurea laudī.

q-cicero-quousque.ipa: /kʷoː ˈuːs.kʷɛ ˈtan.dɛm a.buː.ˈteː.rɛ ka.tɪ.ˈliː.na pa.tɪ.ˈɛn.tɪ.aː ˈnɔs.traː/
q-cicero-quousque.respelling: kwoh OOS-kweh TAHN-dehm ah-boo-TAY-reh kah-tih-LEE-nah pah-tih-EHN-tih-ah NOS-trah
q-cicero-quousque.latin: Quō ūsque tandem abūtēre, Catilīna, patientiā nostrā?

q-virgil-tantae.respelling: TAHN-teye MOH-lihs EH-raht roh-MAH-nahm KON-deh-reh GEHN-tehm
q-virgil-tantae.latin: Tantae mōlis erat Rōmānam condere gentem!

q-juvenal-panem.ipa: /ˈdʊ.aːs ˈtan.tʊm reːs ˈaŋk.sɪ.ʊs ˈɔp.tat ˈpaː.nɛm ɛt kɪr.ˈkeːn.seːs/
q-juvenal-panem.respelling: DU-ahs TAHN-tum rays AHNGK-sih-us OP-taht PAH-nehm eht kihr-KAYN-says
q-juvenal-panem.latin: … duās tantum rēs anxius optat, pānem et circēnsēs.

q-ovid-edax.ipa: /ˈtɛm.pʊs ˈɛ.daːks ˈreː.rʊm ˈtuː.kʷɛ ɪn.wɪ.dɪ.ˈoː.sa wɛ.ˈtʊs.taːs ˈɔm.nɪ.a deːs.ˈtrʊ.ɪ.tɪs/
q-ovid-edax.respelling: TEHM-pus EH-dahks RAY-rum TOO-kweh ihn-wih-dih-OH-sah weh-TUS-tahs OM-nih-ah days-TRU-ih-tihs
q-ovid-edax.latin: Tempus edāx rērum, tūque, invidiōsa vetustās, omnia dēstruitis.

q-vulg-fiat-lux.ipa: /diːk.ˈsɪt.kʷɛ ˈdɛ.ʊs ˈfiː.at luːks ɛt ˈfak.ta ɛst luːks/
q-vulg-fiat-lux.respelling: deek-SIHT-kweh DEH-us FEE-aht looks eht FAHK-tah ehst looks
q-vulg-fiat-lux.latin: Dīxitque Deus: “Fīat lūx.” Et facta est lūx.

q-vulg-in-principio.ipa: /ɪn priːŋ.ˈkɪ.pɪ.oː ˈɛ.rat ˈwɛr.bʊm ɛt ˈwɛr.bʊm ˈɛ.rat ˈa.pʊd ˈdɛ.ʊm ɛt ˈdɛ.ʊs ˈɛ.rat ˈwɛr.bʊm/
q-vulg-in-principio.respelling: ihn preeng-KIH-pih-oh EH-raht WEHR-bum eht WEHR-bum EH-raht AH-pud DEH-um eht DEH-us EH-raht WEHR-bum
q-vulg-in-principio.latin: In prīncipiō erat Verbum, et Verbum erat apud Deum, et Deus erat Verbum.

q-bede-discere.ipa: /ˈsɛm.pɛr au̯t ˈdɪs.kɛ.rɛ au̯t dɔ.ˈkeː.rɛ au̯t ˈskriː.bɛ.rɛ ˈdʊl.kɛ ˈha.bʊ.iː/
q-bede-discere.respelling: SEHM-pehr owt DIHS-keh-reh owt do-KAY-reh owt SKREE-beh-reh DUL-keh HAH-bu-ee
q-bede-discere.latin: Semper aut discere aut docēre aut scrībere dulce habuī.

q-alcuin-epitaph.ipa: /kʷɔd nʊŋk ɛs ˈfʊ.ɛ.ram ɛt kʷɔd nʊŋk ˈɛ.gɔ sʊm ˈtuː.kʷɛ fʊ.ˈtuː.rʊs ˈɛ.rɪs/
q-alcuin-epitaph.respelling: kwod nungk ehs FU-eh-rahm eht kwod nungk EH-go sum TOO-kweh fu-TOO-rus EH-rihs
q-alcuin-epitaph.latin: Quod nunc es fueram, … et quod nunc ego sum, tūque futūrus eris.

q-vulg-pater-noster.ipa: /ˈpa.tɛr ˈnɔs.tɛr kʷiː ɛs ɪn ˈkae̯.liːs saːŋk.tɪ.fɪ.ˈkeː.tʊr ˈnoː.mɛn ˈtʊ.ʊm/
q-vulg-pater-noster.respelling: PAH-tehr NOS-tehr kwee ehs ihn KEYE-lees sahngk-tih-fih-KAY-tur NOH-mehn TU-um
q-vulg-pater-noster.latin: Pater noster, quī es in caelīs, sānctificētur nōmen tuum.

q-aug-inquietum.ipa: /feː.ˈkɪs.tiː noːs ad teː ɛt ɪŋ.kʷɪ.ˈeː.tʊm ɛst kɔr ˈnɔs.trʊm ˈdoː.nɛk rɛ.kʷɪ.ˈeːs.kat ɪn teː/
q-aug-inquietum.respelling: fay-KIHS-tee nohs ahd tay eht ihng-kwih-AY-tum ehst kor NOS-trum DOH-nehk reh-kwih-AYS-kaht ihn tay
q-aug-inquietum.latin: Fēcistī nōs ad tē, et inquiētum est cor nostrum, dōnec requiēscat in tē.

q-ben-ausculta.ipa: /ɔps.ˈkʊl.taː oː ˈfiː.liː prae̯.ˈkɛp.ta ma.ˈgɪs.triː ɛt ɪŋ.ˈkliː.naː ˈau̯.rɛm ˈkɔr.dɪs ˈtʊ.iː/
q-ben-ausculta.respelling: ops-KUL-tah oh FEE-lee preye-KEHP-tah mah-GIHS-tree eht ihng-KLEE-nah OW-rehm KOR-dihs TU-ee
q-ben-ausculta.latin: Obscultā, ō fīlī, praecepta magistrī, et inclīnā aurem cordis tuī.

q-vulg-gloria.ipa: /ˈgloː.rɪ.a ɪn al.ˈtɪs.sɪ.miːs ˈdɛ.oː ɛt ɪn ˈtɛr.raː paːks ɪn hɔ.ˈmɪ.nɪ.bʊs ˈbɔ.nae̯ wɔ.lʊn.ˈtaː.tɪs/
q-vulg-gloria.respelling: GLOH-rih-ah ihn ahl-TIHS-sih-mees DEH-oh eht ihn TEHR-rah pahks ihn ho-MIH-nih-bus BO-neye wo-lun-TAH-tihs
q-vulg-gloria.latin: Glōria in altissimīs Deō, et in terrā pāx in hominibus bonae voluntātis.

q-aug-sero.ipa: /ˈseː.roː teː a.ˈmaː.wiː pʊl.kʰrɪ.ˈtuː.doː tam an.ˈtiː.kʷa ɛt tam ˈnɔ.wa ˈseː.roː teː a.ˈmaː.wiː/
q-aug-sero.respelling: SAY-roh tay ah-MAH-wee pul-krih-TOO-doh tahm ahn-TEE-kwah eht tahm NO-wah SAY-roh tay ah-MAH-wee
q-aug-sero.latin: Sērō tē amāvī, pulchritūdō tam antīqua et tam nova, sērō tē amāvī!

q-aug-da-mihi.ipa: /daː ˈmɪ.hɪ kas.tɪ.ˈtaː.tɛm ɛt kɔn.tɪ.ˈnɛn.tɪ.am sɛd ˈnoː.liː ˈmɔ.dɔ/
q-aug-da-mihi.respelling: dah MIH-hih kahs-tih-TAH-tehm eht kon-tih-NEHN-tih-ahm sehd NOH-lee MO-do
q-aug-da-mihi.latin: Dā mihi castitātem et continentiam, sed nōlī modo.

q-vulg-de-profundis.respelling: day pro-FUN-dees klah-MAH-wee ahd tay DO-mih-neh
q-vulg-de-profundis.latin: Dē profundīs clāmāvī ad tē, Domine.

q-abelard-dubitando.ipa: /dʊ.bɪ.ˈtan.doː ˈkʷɪp.pɛ ad ɪŋ.kʷiː.siː.tɪ.ˈoː.nɛm wɛ.ˈniː.mʊs ɪŋ.kʷiː.ˈrɛn.doː weː.rɪ.ˈtaː.tɛm pɛr.ˈkɪ.pɪ.mʊs/
q-abelard-dubitando.respelling: du-bih-TAHN-doh KWIHP-peh ahd ihng-kwee-see-tih-OH-nehm weh-NEE-mus ihng-kwee-REHN-doh way-rih-TAH-tehm pehr-KIH-pih-mus
q-abelard-dubitando.latin: Dubitandō quippe ad inquīsītiōnem venīmus; inquīrendō vēritātem percipimus.

q-dies-irae.ipa: /ˈdɪ.eːs ˈiː.rae̯ ˈdɪ.eːs ˈɪl.la ˈsɔl.wɛt ˈsae̯.klʊm ɪn fa.ˈwiːl.laː/
q-dies-irae.respelling: DIH-ays EE-reye DIH-ays IHL-lah SOL-weht SEYE-klum ihn fah-WEEL-lah
q-dies-irae.latin: Diēs īrae, diēs illa, solvet saeclum in favīllā.

q-magna-carta-39.ipa: /ˈnuːl.lʊs ˈliː.bɛr ˈhɔ.mɔ ka.pɪ.ˈaː.tʊr wɛl ɪm.prɪ.sɔ.ˈneː.tʊr ˈnɪ.sɪ pɛr leː.ˈgaː.lɛ juː.ˈdɪ.kɪ.ʊm ˈpa.rɪ.ʊm sʊ.ˈoː.rʊm wɛl pɛr ˈleː.gɛm ˈtɛr.rae̯/
q-magna-carta-39.respelling: NOOL-lus LEE-behr HO-mo kah-pih-AH-tur wehl ihm-prih-so-NAY-tur NIH-sih pehr lay-GAH-leh yoo-DIH-kih-um PAH-rih-um su-OH-rum wehl pehr LAY-gehm TEHR-reye
q-magna-carta-39.latin: Nūllus līber homo capiātur vel imprisonētur … nisi per lēgāle iūdicium parium suōrum vel per lēgem terrae.

q-bede-angli.ipa: /ˈbɛ.nɛ ˈɪŋ.kʷɪt nam ɛt aŋ.ˈgɛ.lɪ.kam ˈha.bɛnt ˈfa.kɪ.ɛm/
q-bede-angli.respelling: BEH-neh IHNG-kwiht nahm eht ahng-GEH-lih-kahm HAH-behnt FAH-kih-ehm

q-vulg-per-speculum.ipa: /wɪ.ˈdeː.mʊs nʊŋk pɛr ˈspɛ.kʊ.lʊm ɪn ae̯.ˈnɪg.ma.tɛ tʊŋk ˈau̯.tɛm ˈfa.kɪ.eː ad ˈfa.kɪ.ɛm/
q-vulg-per-speculum.respelling: wih-DAY-mus nungk pehr SPEH-ku-lum ihn eye-NIHG-mah-teh tungk OW-tehm FAH-kih-ay ahd FAH-kih-ehm
q-vulg-per-speculum.latin: Vidēmus nunc per speculum in aenigmate, tunc autem faciē ad faciem.
